prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: wooden mine scaffold platform: rough planks with iron brackets and ore dust The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a SQUARE seamless repeating tile for a top-down JRPG map: a wooden mine scaffold platform ground texture. Full bleed surface edge-to-edge: rows of rough worn timber planks, seams, occasional small iron joining brackets/nailheads, restrained earthy ore dust caught in crevices. EVENLY DISTRIBUTED detail, no focal subject or objects. EXACT PERIODIC TILING: left edge plank shapes/color/pattern must continue at right edge and top edge must continue at bottom edge, designed as a repeatable tile. Classic steep top-down orthographic RPG map view with no perspective convergence. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, deliberate hand-placed uniform SQUARE pixels, crunchy nearest-neighbor pixels of identical scale throughout (roughly 7–8 output pixels per art pixel), coherent clusters of 3–10 art pixels. No anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, photographic grain/noise, soft brushing, or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy color palette, 4–6 discrete shades per material, hue shifted shadows saturated reddish-purple brown and highlights warm golden yellow. Neutral soft even upper-left ambient illumination, clean base colors; absolutely no cast shadows, nighttime, light sources, glow, lamp light pools or vignette. No borders, frames, people, props, lettering. Output a square texture.
